Driver CPC training

Periodic training for professional lorry and bus drivers who need to keep their Driver Qualification Card up to date. Driver CPC is not a vehicle category.

Enquire about Driver CPCCall 01632 960960

What Driver CPC is

Driver CPC is the professional qualification for people who drive lorries or buses for a living. It is not a vehicle category: Category C and Category C+E are the licences, and Driver CPC sits alongside them for drivers who need a Driver Qualification Card.

The vehicle licences are Category C andCategory C+E.

Who needs it

Professional lorry and bus drivers. Some types of work are exempt, and that depends on the job rather than on anything we can decide for you. Ask us, or check current official guidance, before you book.

Initial and periodic CPC

Two stages of the same qualification. We offer the periodic stage.

  • Initial

    New professional drivers

    Initial CPC is the qualification a new professional driver takes when moving into vocational driving. We explain it here so the difference from periodic CPC is clear.

  • Periodic

    Drivers who already hold a card

    Periodic CPC is ongoing training for a driver who already holds a Driver Qualification Card, so the card stays valid. Drivers need 35 hours of periodic training every five years. Rules can change, so check current official guidance for your own card. We can't calculate anyone's hours on this website.

Courses we offer

What we offer, and what we don't.

  • Offered

    Periodic Driver CPC

    Training modules for drivers who already hold a Driver Qualification Card and need hours towards their five-year requirement. Ask us which modules we are running and when.

  • Not offered

    Initial Driver CPC

    We don't currently offer Initial Driver CPC. If you're a new professional driver who needs it, get in touch and we'll point you in the right direction.

Format and duration

A periodic module is a set block of training, in a classroom or with a practical element, depending on the subject. Module lengths and dates are confirmed when you enquire.

Price and quotes

We don't publish a fixed price list. Ask for a quote for the module or modules you need, and we'll confirm the current fee and dates.

Common questions

What is Driver CPC?

The professional qualification for lorry and bus drivers who need a Driver Qualification Card. It isn't a vehicle category.

What is the difference between initial and periodic CPC?

Initial CPC is for a new professional driver. Periodic CPC is ongoing training for someone who already holds a Driver Qualification Card. We offer periodic training.

Which CPC courses do you offer?

Periodic Driver CPC. We don't currently offer Initial Driver CPC, but we can point you in the right direction if you need it.

Where can I find dates and prices?

We confirm module dates and fees when you enquire, so you get current information for the course you want.
